topic.label: Decision Analysis under Uncertainty
topic.desc: Decision Analysis under Uncertainty: Decision and Risk Analysis, Decision Making under Uncertainty and Organizations, Technology and Strategy.

concepts.label: Decision and Risk Analysis
concepts.desc: Structuring choices under uncertainty with decision trees, utility, value of information and risk preferences.

concepts.label: Organizations, Technology and Strategy
concepts.desc: How firms organise people, adopt technology, innovate and compete, studied with organisation theory and strategy frameworks.

concepts.label: Decision Making under Uncertainty
concepts.desc: Choosing among options when outcomes are uncertain: expected value, risk, regret, reversibility and value of information.

skills.label: Decision Tree Evaluator
skills.desc: Builds and rolls back decision trees to expected value or utility and checks probabilities and payoffs are coherent.

skills.label: Risk Preference Elicitor
skills.desc: Elicits utility curves and risk tolerance from stakeholders and checks answers for consistency across lotteries.

skills.label: Value of Information Calculator
skills.desc: Computes expected value of perfect and sample information and checks it never exceeds the value of perfect information.

skills.label: Competitive Strategy Mapper
skills.desc: Analyses industry structure and competitive positioning and checks claims against market and firm data.

skills.label: Organization Design Assessor
skills.desc: Maps structure, incentives and coordination in a team or firm and checks findings against interview or survey evidence.

skills.label: Technology Adoption Analyst
skills.desc: Fits diffusion curves to adoption data and checks fit quality and forecast plausibility.

skills.label: Expected Value Calculator
skills.desc: Computes expected value and downside for each option from probabilities and payoffs and flags numbers that are guesses.

skills.label: Game and Incentive Analyst
skills.desc: Maps players, options and payoffs, finds stable outcomes and says how the answer changes if players cooperate or deceive.

skills.label: Option Evaluator
skills.desc: Scores options on stated criteria with weights, shows how the ranking changes when the weights change and names the decision rule.

skills.label: Reversibility Assessor
skills.desc: Separates choices that can be undone cheaply from those that cannot and recommends how much evidence each deserves.
